## Summary of Changes

Describe the proposed changes, the motivations behind them, and what problem they solve.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New adapter / connector (e.g., Jira, Notion, Confluence, GitHub)
- [ ] Security enhancement (e.g., secret scrubbing pattern, HMAC signature validation)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance enhancement or refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] Unit tests covering the new functionality or regression are added/updated.
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` or `README.md` is updated if applicable.
- [ ] Type annotations pass cleanly.
- [ ] Full test suite passes: `pytest`
